channel.title: Russia's war in Ukraine · Varde Monitor
channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in Russia's war in Ukraine.

item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy facilities, including a strike that killed 17 in Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. President Trump announced an alleged Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire linked to a diesel deal, prompting Ukraine to call the claim false after further strikes. The Houthi movement launched a second missile attack on Riyadh airport, killing a Pakistani national and wounding several people, leading Saudi Arabia to extend airport suspensions. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
